content.text:
Image 1: Eight-panel storyboard reference, used for the overall shot structure, shot sizes, and camera-movement rhythm. Read it from left to right and from top to bottom; panel N is Shot N. It is a line-art sketch: do not adopt its sketch style, black outlines, white background, panel borders or drawn faces.
Image 2: Reference of Jail, a cell, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, a rendered set, not live action. Use it only for the room's layout, the furniture's positions and the light's direction; do not reference its visual content. It contains no people.
Image 3: Reference of Jail, a cell, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 4: Reference of Jail, a cell, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 5: Reference of Jail, a cell, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 6: Reference of Jail, a cell, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 7: Blocking reference of the segment's start: the same place with these people in their places, used only for where each person is and which way they face; take faces and outfits from each subject's own image. It is a line-art diagram: do not adopt its outlines or white background.
Image 8: Subject 1 (Sebastian, look S0) character appearance reference.
Image 9: Subject 2 (Officer) character appearance reference.
[Subject settings]
Subject 1 (Sebastian): Refer to Image 8. 30, the hero; the scorned illegitimate son of the Klein family, jailed for three days for reckless driving and secretly a billionaire running a plan. Outfit: look S0: An orange short-sleeved prison-issue top that fits his athletic frame closely across the broad shoulders and chest, over a fitted black long-sleeved thermal undershirt, well-fitted orange prison-issue drawstring trousers that sit neatly on his hips and legs, and plain white slip-on canvas shoes. No watch. Signature colour: black.
Subject 2 (Officer): Refer to Image 9. 50, a gruff jail corrections officer who releases Sebastian. Outfit: A dark-navy long-sleeved corrections uniform shirt with plain cloth shoulder patches and no lettering, a plain metal badge, dark-navy uniform trousers, a wide brown leather duty belt with pouches and a key ring, and black work boots. Signature colour: brown.
Environment (Jail, a cell): Refer to Images 2 to 6. Day, cold flat fluorescent top light with a pale shaft of daylight from the high window. Caged fluorescent tube on the ceiling gives cold flat white top light; a pale shaft of daylight slants from the barred high window in the back wall. Live sound: fluorescent hum, distant echoing jail noise, keys, clanging bars.
Do not swap the characters' appearances, clothing, actions, positions or dialogue.
[Subjects and relationships]
Only two people appear throughout: Sebastian and Officer.
[Blocking]
Refer to Images 2 to 6 for the room and Image 7 for the people's places. Camera on the front-wall side of the cell, looking toward the back wall, the steel bunk along the left wall and the barred cell door in the right wall. Sebastian, in the orange prison-issue top and trousers, lies on his side on the thin grey mattress of the one steel bunk along the left wall, his back to the barred cell door, facing the wall, the folded grey blanket at his feet. Officer is walking up the dim corridor outside, toward the barred cell door in the right wall. The one barred high window is in the back wall; the steel toilet-sink unit stands in the back-right corner by the door.
[Overall style]
Photorealistic live-action short drama with cinematic lighting. Each character keeps the face and the outfit with its main colour from their reference image throughout. Use each character sheet only for that character: the face from the close-up on the right, the body and outfit from the turnaround on the left; do not render the sheet's layout, white background or multiple views. This segment has 5 lines, in this order: Officer, Officer, Officer, Sebastian, Officer. Generate speech only from the lines in {} in the shot list, each spoken exactly once by its speaker; everyone else keeps their mouth naturally closed while listening, and a V.O. speaker keeps their mouth closed or is off screen. Follow the shot list below; do not add cuts or camera moves beyond it. Strictly adhere to the 180-degree rule: within a scene, characters keep their screen sides and the camera stays on one side of the axis. Seamless continuity of action, spatial matching and consistent actor blocking; cut on action. For dialogue prefer static shot-reverse-shot and over-the-shoulder shots, balanced with reaction shots and close-up inserts. Faces stable and clear, consistent with the reference images, with no resemblance to any real actor or actress. Normal human eyes. Natural anatomy and hands. Natural, fluid motion that follows the blocking; characters make subtle, natural movements. Characters, props and environment share one world with matched lighting. Each line ends naturally with breathing room and is never cut off. Authentic performances with micro-expressions. No BGM; generate only dialogue, environmental sounds and action sounds. No subtitles.
[Continuity]
Maintain continuity in the identities, number, appearance, clothing, relative heights, spatial positions, and eyelines of all the characters. The actions in the shot list occur strictly in sequence. Hands are anatomically correct.
[Strictly exclude]
added or missing characters, spatial jumps. lettering or text on uniforms. malformed hands on the bars. Dialogue from the wrong character, multiple people speaking at once, repeated or missing lines, lip-sync errors and audio-visual desynchronization. The raw reference images (character sheets, setting plates) appearing as a frame of the video, and starting on a still frame of the setting reference. A fast zoom-in at the start, a fast pull-back at the end, unmotivated whip-pans, tilts, zooms and 360-degree orbits. Axis-crossing, jump cuts, frame skips, flicker and clipping. Face swaps, changes in age or clothing, sudden height shifts, added or missing characters, spatial jumps, and disordered action sequences; props popping in or vanishing, and duplicate characters except mirror reflections. Hand clipping, extra fingers, fused fingers, malformed hands. Subtitles, captions, watermarks and garbled writing; writing and logos other than those on a key prop's reference image, which are copied from it; a phone screen or paper that is not a key prop is shown from the back or out of focus. Black-and-white, monochrome, grayscale, desaturated visuals; hand-drawn, sketch, line art, illustration, comics, animation; storyboard frames, rough sketches, panel borders, gutters and grid layouts.
[Shot list] (8 shots, approximately 20 seconds)
When a previous-shot reference image is given, it is the moment this segment starts from: keep its people's positions, outfits, props and light, and continue from there. Shot 1 keeps its own camera, matching the image's framing only when it frames the same view; do not repeat that frame later.
Shot 1 (0-2s): [Extreme wide shot, locked-off camera, low angle, establishing insert outside the jail] The blocky grey concrete jail building behind a tall chain-link fence topped with coils of razor wire, under a clear sky. <wind rattles the chain-link fence>
Shot 2 (2-4s): [Wide shot, slow push in, high angle from the front-wall side of the cell] Sebastian lies on the steel bunk along the left wall, his back to the barred cell door, facing the grey-green wall, a shaft of daylight slanting down from the barred high window. <fluorescent light hums>
Shot 3 (4-7s): [Medium shot, clean single, eye level from the front-wall side, framing the barred cell door] Officer steps up to the barred cell door from the dim corridor, grips a steel bar with one hand and glares toward the bunk. <heavy boots stop, keys jangle> Dialogue (Officer, in English, gruff bark): {Klein, get up.}
Shot 4 (7-9s): [Medium close-up, clean single, locked-off camera, eye level, framed tight on Sebastian's head and shoulder on the pillow] Sebastian lies facing the wall with his eyes open, calm, and does not turn around; the Officer is off screen. Dialogue (Officer, in English, impatient): {It's time to go.}
Shot 5 (9-12s): [Close-up, handheld camera, low angle on the Officer through the bars] Officer bangs his key ring hard against the steel bars of the cell door, his face red and furious. <metal clangs on the bars> Dialogue (Officer, in English, shouting): {Hurry the fuck up, Klein! I said move it!}
Shot 6 (12-15s): [Medium shot, slow pan from the bunk toward the door, eye level from the front-wall side] Sebastian rolls over toward the barred cell door and slowly sits up on the edge of the steel bunk, his feet in the white slip-on canvas shoes on the floor, while the Officer stands at the barred door with his hand on the bars. <bunk springs creak>
Shot 7 (15-17s): [Medium close-up, clean single, locked-off camera, eye level, tight on Sebastian's face and shoulders] Sebastian rubs the back of his neck and gives a lazy, amused half-smile toward the door. Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, lazy and teasing): {Geez, officer, what is the rush?}
Shot 8 (17-20s): [Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot from behind Sebastian's shoulder on the front-wall side, toward the barred door] Officer turns a key in the lock and slides the barred cell door open, then stands in the open doorway frowning at Sebastian on the bunk. <lock clicks, the steel door slides open> Dialogue (Officer, in English, gruff and disbelieving): {Most people wanna get out of here faster.}
At the end: Sebastian, in the orange prison-issue top and trousers, sits on the edge of the steel bunk along the left wall, feet on the floor, facing the barred cell door. Officer stands in the open barred cell doorway in the right wall, facing Sebastian, the key ring in his hand. Camera on the front-wall side.

Image 10 is the first frame.
